name: RG1.9 the preset selector lists every preset /api/presets serves, by its registry name, in registry order
RG1.9 both APRA presets are listed, with names matching the registry
js: await (async()=>{const d=await (await fetch('/api/presets')).json();const want=['apra-cps-234','apra-cps-230'];const bad=[];want.forEach(id=>{const p=d.presets.find(x=>x.id===id);const opt=document.querySelector('#policy-preset option[value="'+id+'"]');const row=document.querySelector('#preset-catalog-tbody tr[data-preset-id="'+id+'"]');if(!p||!opt||!row||opt.textContent!==p.name||row.children[1].textContent!==p.name||!/^APRA CPS 23[04] /.test(p.name))bad.push(id+': '+(p&&p.name)+' / '+(opt&&opt.textContent));});return bad.length===0||bad.join('; ');})()

name: RG1.9 the registry table shows each APRA preset's rule counts by status (CPS 234 7/19/4/0, CPS 230 4/26/6/0)
RG1.9 the page says plainly that presets are not enforced on the request path
js: (()=>{const e=document.getElementById('preset-enforcement');const t=e?e.innerText:'';const b=document.getElementById('policy-active-badge').textContent;return (/Presets are not enforced on the request path\./.test(t)&&/no rule below allows, blocks or warns on a request/.test(t)&&e.offsetParent!==null&&/not enforced/.test(b))||JSON.stringify({t,b});})()

name: RG1.9 selecting CPS 230 shows every registry rule with its registry status, and cps230-degrade-to-local is UNIMPLEMENTED
RG1.9 no rule of any preset is shown as enforced or active, and every evaluable rule says it is not enforced
js: await (async()=>{const d=await (await fetch('/api/presets')).json();const s=document.getElementById('policy-preset');const bad=[];let evaluable=0;for(const p of d.presets){s.value=p.id;onPolicyPresetChange();document.querySelectorAll('#preset-rules-tbody tr').forEach(r=>{const t=r.querySelector('.rule-status').textContent;const st=r.dataset.status;if((/enforced/i.test(t)&&!/not enforced/i.test(t))||/\bactive\b/i.test(t))bad.push(p.id+':'+r.dataset.ruleId+'='+t);if(st==='evaluable'){evaluable++;if(t!=='Evaluable, not enforced')bad.push(p.id+':'+r.dataset.ruleId+' evaluable shown as '+t);}if(st==='unimplemented'&&t!=='UNIMPLEMENTED')bad.push(p.id+':'+r.dataset.ruleId+' unimplemented shown as '+t);});}return (bad.length===0&&evaluable>=11)||(bad.slice(0,6).join('; ')+' evaluable='+evaluable);})()

name: RG1.9 the page's own source holds no preset: no registry id or name is written into it
js: await (async()=>{const d=await (await fetch('/api/presets')).json();const src=await (await fetch('/governance')).text();const hits=d.presets.filter(p=>src.indexOf("'"+p.id+"'")>=0||src.indexOf('"'+p.id+'"')>=0||src.indexOf('>'+p.name+'<')>=0||src.indexOf("'"+p.name+"'")>=0).map(p=>p.id);return hits.length===0||('hard-coded in the page: '+hits.join(', '));})()

name: RG1.9 drift guard: a registry with a preset added and a rule reclassified changes what the page shows
js: await (async()=>{const real=await (await fetch('/api/presets')).json();const d=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(real));d.presets.push({id:'test-drift-preset',name:'Drift Guard Test Preset',jurisdiction:'XX',description:'test',source:'builtin:test',classification_default:'internal',approval_above:'restricted',cross_border_allowed:true,blocked:[],counts:{evaluable:1,documentation:0,unimplemented:0,unclassified:0},rules:[{id:'drift-rule',status:'evaluable',action:'warn',severity:'low',description:'EVALUABLE \u2014 test'}]});const c=d.presets.find(p=>p.id==='apra-cps-230');c.rules.find(r=>r.id==='cps230-degrade-to-local').status='evaluable';const of=window.fetch;window.fetch=function(u,o){if(String(u).indexOf('/api/presets')>=0)return Promise.resolve(new Response(JSON.stringify(d),{status:200}));return of.apply(this,arguments);};let out;try{await loadPresetCatalog();const opt=document.querySelector('#policy-preset option[value="test-drift-preset"]');const row=document.querySelector('#preset-catalog-tbody tr[data-preset-id="test-drift-preset"]');const s=document.getElementById('policy-preset');s.value='apra-cps-230';onPolicyPresetChange();const deg=document.querySelector('#preset-rules-tbody tr[data-rule-id="cps230-degrade-to-local"] .rule-status');out={opt:!!opt&&opt.textContent==='Drift Guard Test Preset',row:!!row,deg:deg?deg.textContent:'missing'};}finally{window.fetch=of;}await loadPresetCatalog();const gone=!document.querySelector('#policy-preset option[value="test-drift-preset"]');const s2=document.getElementById('policy-preset');s2.value='apra-cps-230';onPolicyPresetChange();const back=document.querySelector('#preset-rules-tbody tr[data-rule-id="cps230-degrade-to-local"] .rule-status').textContent;return (out.opt&&out.row&&out.deg==='Evaluable, not enforced'&&gone&&back==='UNIMPLEMENTED')||JSON.stringify(Object.assign(out,{gone,back}));})()
